name: Elena Papadopoulou
notes: Repeat customer. Prefers a phone call before any part is ordered.

repairs.reported_issue: Will not charge with either of two USB-C adapters. Works from the dock.
repairs.notes: Original 65 W adapter and cable included in the bag.

work.body: Measured 5 V on both adapters and no negotiation on CC. Cleaned the barrel of the left port.
Right-hand USB-C port charges at 61 W with the bench supply.

repairs.reported_issue: Cracked screen after a fall on the stairs. Touch still works.
repairs.notes: Face ID and both cameras were tested at intake and work.

name: Christos Georgiou
notes: Brings devices in during the morning. Invoice to the company, not to him.

repairs.reported_issue: Fan runs at full speed from power-on and the case gets very hot.
repairs.notes: Windows 11 installed, local account only, no recovery password supplied.

work.body: Removed the base panel. Heatsink fins are packed with dust and the fan bearing is dry.
Called the customer: a replacement fan is required, about three working days.

repairs.reported_issue: Charges only when the cable is held at an angle.
repairs.notes: Child's tablet, cosmetic scratches on the back, no case supplied.

work.body: Replaced the USB-C port and cleaned the charge flex connector.
Charged from 3% to 100% with the customer cable, no movement needed.
Explained that the original cable is worn and should be replaced.

name: Maria Ioannou
notes: Waits for the device in the shop when the repair is quick.

repairs.reported_issue: Left third of the panel shows a green tint after ten minutes.
repairs.notes: Stand, power cable and USB-C cable supplied. Serial on the back confirmed.

work.body: Reproduced the tint on two inputs and with two cables. Panel itself is suspect.
Ran the panel on the bench for four hours: tint returns at 38 degrees C.

repairs.reported_issue: Prints a dark band down the right side and jams on the second page.
repairs.notes: One third-party toner cartridge installed, not the original.

work.body: Replaced the fuser and cleaned the paper path. Dark band was a scored drum.
Customer is testing twenty pages of invoices at the office.

name: Andreas Andreou
notes: Owns three shops; asks for one invoice per device.

repairs.reported_issue: Screen has a bright spot and one dead line at the bottom.

work.body: Fitted a replacement display assembly and transferred the camera bracket.
TrueTone, brightness steps, camera and sleep wake all pass.
Customer inspected the panel and paid by card.

repairs.reported_issue: Battery lasts half a day and the phone shuts down at 15%.
repairs.notes: Water damage indicators are white. Original back glass has a hairline crack.

work.body: Battery health reported 71%. Removed the old cell without damaging the coil.
Full charge, forty minutes of video and a cold boot at 5% all pass.

repairs.reported_issue: Clicks and drops from the system whenever a large file is copied.
repairs.notes: Customer was told at intake that data recovery is not part of this repair.

work.body: Drive reports reallocated sectors and fails a full-surface read. Controller is sealed.
Returned unopened. Customer will send it to a recovery lab.

name: Sofia Christodoulou
notes: Books repairs by email and asks for written estimates.

repairs.reported_issue: About ten keys do not register unless the deck is pressed down.
repairs.notes: UK layout. Laptop sleeve and charger included.

work.body: Replaced the keyboard deck. Ribbon was creased under the right speaker.
Emailed the customer to test the number row and the arrow cluster at home.

repairs.reported_issue: Right earcup crackles when noise cancelling is enabled.
repairs.notes: Carry case, cable and airplane adapter supplied.

work.body: Crackle follows the noise-cancelling board, not the driver. Reseated the ribbon.
Two hours with ANC on: one crackle in the first minute, none after.

name: Nikos Vasiliou
notes: Pays cash. Collects on Saturdays only.

repairs.reported_issue: Shuts down after twenty minutes in games and the fan is very loud.
repairs.notes: Vertical stand and one controller supplied. Games stay with the customer.

work.body: Removed the side panels and the heatsink. Vents almost fully blocked with dust and pet hair.
Liquid metal looks intact. Do not tilt the console while the cooler is off.

repairs.reported_issue: Battery drops from 80% to 20% during a video call.
repairs.notes: Back glass cracked at the corner; customer declined that repair.

work.body: Battery health 74% and a rising internal resistance. Ordered an original cell.
SMS sent with the part lead time and the pickup window.

name: Anna Michaelidou
notes: School account. Purchase order number required on the invoice.

repairs.reported_issue: No picture on the internal screen, external HDMI works fine.
repairs.notes: School asset tag 0442. Charger and VGA adapter included.

work.body: Replaced the display cable; the old one had a pinched section behind the hinge.
Full brightness, lid angle sweep and a fifty-cycle open and close check.
Signed out on the school purchase order, copy filed in the ticket.

repairs.reported_issue: Black ink stops printing halfway down a page, colour is fine.
repairs.notes: Compatible cartridges fitted by the customer. Nozzle check supplied.

repairs.reported_issue: Random restarts under load, no blue screen.
repairs.notes: Power cable included. Customer asked to preserve the Windows installation.

work.body: Power supply drops the 12 V rail to 11.1 V under load. Board and RAM test clean.
Customer collects it and will replace the power supply himself.

name: Kostas Theodorou
notes: New customer from the Paphos shop referral. Email invoice only.

repairs.reported_issue: Slow since an update and the fan is noisy at idle.
repairs.notes: One 256 GB NVMe drive, no external backup supplied.

work.body: Cloned the drive to a 1 TB SSD, replaced the fan and removed two startup programs.
Cold boot 24 s, idle fan inaudible, drive at 34 degrees C after an hour.

repairs.reported_issue: Digitizer does not respond along the left edge in portrait.
repairs.notes: Pencil supplied to test. Case left at home.

work.body: Replaced the digitiser and transferred the home button bracket.
Touch sweep across all four edges and a Pencil line test pass.
